role: V, 2D numerical diagnostic on archived e060. The new 3D campaigns are the primary research.

selection.method: Choose the lowest trial_index with numerical_failure and the lowest trial_index with ok, in each fixed half-open b bin. Include 3.5 in the last bin. Record an empty stratum explicitly and do not replace it.
selection.outcome_knowledge: Original archived validity labels are used to stratify a diagnostic, not to estimate a blind discovery rate.

procedure.initial: The original N, seed, fixed Gaussian noise with exact mean subtraction, and per-record parameters.
procedure.time: Use the original 2500 settle and 800 hold macro steps, dt=0.2. Freeze the original integer quench split before substepping to preserve all physical times.
procedure.solver: Reuse the identical historical semi-implicit Swift-Hohenberg step with no clipping or changed classification thresholds.
procedure.observations: Keep the initial, settle and final arrays, or the last finite field and exact failure time. Record legacy label, all refined labels, RMS differences, and parameter-bin failure counts.

claim_scope: Diagnostic outcomes concern selected historical 2D settings only. The exercise does not estimate a full-grid rescue rate or advance an emergence level.
